places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus bakes biscuits at sunrise; over breakfast Call floats a trail drive and offers Dish work, then spots Deets riding in with Jake Spoon.
places.location_hint: on the Rio Grande flats with low bluffs to the south; stage road runs north from it through brush toward San Antonio

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Sunrise lights the flats along it; Dish imagines taking Lorena for a buggy ride beside it.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Call plans to ride down that night to gather stock, possibly enough for a herd to drive north.

places.name: Saltillo
places.note: Call says bedbugs there once bit him worse than the mare did.

places.name: Georgia
places.note: Pea Eye's mother died there when he was six.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Newt admires Dish for having trailed cattle there more than once.

places.name: Pickles Gap
places.note: Augustus mocks Call's herd idea by suggesting they drive it there.
places.location_hint: about twelve miles from Lonesome Dove in the mesquite brush

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Deets was sent there three days earlier to deposit money; the stage road north from town leads to it.

places.name: Brush Country
places.note: Call wants a good drive to pay for better land beyond this scrub country, which the stage road runs through.
places.location_hint: south Texas scrub between the Rio Grande and San Antonio

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: Dish has a sure trail job waiting back there but considers staying with the Hat Creek outfit.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: on the back porch of the outfit's house

groups.label: Deets and Jake Spoon
groups.hint: riding in along the stage road from San Antonio, just north of town
